takes.action: On the Bronx court bench in late sun he holds both laces of his black ORVO high-top and pulls them tight in one firm, smooth tug, his face calm and focused on the shoe, not smiling. The camera starts moving forward.
The same shot runs on without a break: he gives the laces one last firm pull, lets go, and sits back slowly on the bench, resting his forearms on his knees, calm and focused. The lace stays tied.

Close on his face on the bench in the warm late sun: his eyes stay closed, he breathes in slowly and deeply, perfectly still and calm, the inward look of a man picturing his big game. Only his breath moves him; the camera holds close, drifting in a touch.

Out of the light he opens his eyes: he is standing on the centre circle of a packed arena in the royal-blue number 11 uniform. He looks around for a beat, takes it in, then rolls his shoulders and jogs into the play as both teams move around him. The camera pulls back low from the hardwood.
He catches a teammate's chest pass and in one motion fires it to the right wing, already running. The camera tracks low along the sideline.
He sprints toward the elbow, plants his black ORVO high-top hard and cuts past his marker, taking the bounce pass back in stride. The camera stays at hardwood level close to his planting foot.

He sells a drive with his shoulder, snaps a low crossover in front of the defender in white number 12 and bursts past his hip; the defender stumbles a step late. The camera tracks from a low sideline angle.

Real-time game speed: he rises into a pull-up jump shot near the elbow and releases at once; the ball travels on a quick, natural arc and in under a second drops cleanly through the net with a snap of the cords. He lands softly on his black ORVO high-tops and jogs back down the court with a calm nod as the crowd jumps up roaring. The camera follows from the sideline.

court.name: the outdoor Bronx street court in late sun, chain-link fence and brick buildings around it, where he sits alone on the bench
